definitions.full: H2032. heron or herayon הֵרָיוֺן noun [masculine] conception, pregnancy ; — ׳ה absolute Hosea 9:11 ; Ruth 4:13 ; suffix הֵרֹנֵךְ Gen 3:16 , either contracted, so Ew § 214 a , or erroneous for הריונך which stands in ⅏ compare Di; — conception , in combination וּמֵהֵרָי֑וֺן וּמִבֶּטֶן מִלֵּדָה Hosea 9:11 ; י ׳וַיִּתֵּן ה ׳לָהּ וַתֵּלֶד Ruth 4:13 ; וְהֵרֹנֵךְ עִצְּבוֺנֵךְ Gen 3:16 (|| תֵּלְדִי ).
